records.justification: The agent's text correctly identifies the purpose of the grants and the eligibility criteria for junior scientist members of the Genetics Society attending genetics research conferences, but omits all details about the three different streams of funding and their respective amounts.

claims.text: The funding is for conference support.
There are three streams of support.
Stream A offers up to £200 for travel and accommodation for Genetics Society or Special Interest Group meetings.
Stream B offers up to £500 for non-Society genetics conferences.
Stream B offers up to £750 for two Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards a year for PhD students only.
Stream C offers up to £300 for registration for virtual conferences.
The grants support the attendance of Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members at conferences on research in Genetics.

records.justification: The agent's text accurately reflects the purpose of the grants as stated in the first sentence of the provided page text.

claims.text: The purpose of these grants is to support the attendance of Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members at conferences on research in Genetics.

records.justification: The agent's text accurately reflects the eligibility criteria, purpose, and deadline for the grant as stated in the provided page text.

claims.text: Grants are available to support undergraduate students.
The grants support students to gain experience in any area of genetics.
The experience is gained by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.
The deadline for 2026 applications is March 31st, 2026.

records.justification: The agent's text accurately captures the eligibility criteria for student and postdoctoral members, as well as the requirement for supervisors to be current members of the Genetics Society.

claims.text: Applicants must be undergraduate, Master's, or PhD student members of the Genetics Society.
Applicants must be postdoctoral members of the Genetics Society within six years of their PhD viva.
Supervisors must be current members of the Genetics Society.
